interactiveFee.title: See what pay-as-you-go could cost.
interactiveFee.invalidOrders: Enter a whole number of orders, zero or more.
interactiveFee.invalidAmount: Enter a USD amount with up to two decimals.
interactiveFee.invalid: Enter valid, non-negative values to see an estimate.
interactiveFee.formula: Each order is rounded to cents at {rate}%, then summed up to the {cap} calendar-month cap.
interactiveFee.noCheaper: None of the standard flat plans has a lower monthly price at this estimate.
interactiveFee.qualification: This assumes every order equals your average value. Actual fees round each order separately; account terms can differ. This compares prices only, not plan limits or features.
